description: This source file defines shared JSDoc type-like definitions for use across a project, including types for TimeRange, GlobalFilters, Role, and RBACContext. It also implements a utility function 'canAccess' for role-based access control checks, intended for use in future API integrations. The file uses JSDoc annotations for type definitions and provides a minimal RBAC utility function.

methods.name: canAccess(ctx, allowedRoles)
methods.description: Checks if any role in allowedRoles exists within the ctx.roles set and returns true if so, otherwise false.
